status: Exact additive source contract; implementation/qualification pending.
unchanged: canonical-delivery-edits/v1, its request schema and one-shot permit semantics remain byte-for-byte unchanged. These new endpoints do not gate existing explicit direct edits on schema27.

query.after: optional UUID exclusive workspace keyset cursor

reply.workspaces: raw registered workspace rows, including revoked rows for administrator CAS discovery

GET agents/{agent}/resources.actor: Canonical administrator for a same-authority agent, or that owner agent only. Other agents and nonadministrator services denied before data lookup.

query.after: optional UUID exclusive workspace keyset cursor

GET agents/{agent}/resources.visibility: Administrators can discover revoked/current rows for CAS. Owner agents see only active read-permitted roots/grants and enabled placement, filtered before pagination; write=false resources remain readable.

GET agents/{agent}/resource-defaults/{ho.reply: hollywood-agent-resource-default/v1 view below; one selection and at most one eligible resource.

PUT agents/{agent}/resource-defaults/{ho.actor: Canonical administrator only; existing native source-v2/current participation business-effect checks and original administrative operation recovery.

body.revision: integer>=0 CAS; 0 only when no pointer

PUT agents/{agent}/resource-defaults/{ho.selected: All three nullable fields must be nonnull and match the current active read/write agent grant and registered root. Agent must be active with enabled placement on the path host. V1 default routing is local: root.host must equal this execution host; remote/adapter compatibility is not inferred.
PUT agents/{agent}/resource-defaults/{ho.cleared: All three fields must be null. Explicitly clears routing only; never selects a replacement or alters access/locks.
PUT agents/{agent}/resource-defaults/{ho.reply: Fresh default view; always mayApply=false. Cached administrative receipt is original evidence, not current routing authority.
PUT agents/{agent}/resource-defaults/{ho.concurrency: Separate per-agent/per-execution-host pointer revision; no unrelated access-grant revision change. Append-only selection revision snapshots plus existing administrative receipts.

GET collaboration/delivery-resource-defa.actor: Existing registered service controller for the delivery execution host.
GET collaboration/delivery-resource-defa.reply: {schema:hollywood-delivery-resource-default/v1,deliveryId,agentId,executionHost,default:<single view>,mayApply:false}. Works for ordinary and structured deliveries; never changes their scope or bypasses planned work/consent/resource grants.
GET collaboration/delivery-resource-defa.limits: Uses canonical delivery.agent/host, never caller-supplied subject, private cwd or room/work context binding.

defaultView.resource: null or {workspace:<raw root>,grant:<raw grant>} only when canonical selection is currently eligible

bounds.cursor: UUID workspace keyset, query scope reauthorized each request; not a frozen multi-page snapshot
bounds.oversize: Refuse without truncation; request a smaller page. No credentials, private native history or source instruction bodies in metadata.
bounds.consistency: Shared authority fence with resource/default writes; each page reflects current canonical state. CAS revisions must still be checked at mutation.

rules: Selection is routing metadata, never access authority or an apply grant. Current root/grant revisions, state, write rights and actual protected root/callback checks remain mandatory.

Pins root and agent-grant revisions at selection. Revocation, regrant, changed registration, disabled placement/principal or incompatible local host makes the pointer held; no silent revival/fallback.
Missing/cleared/held or unsupported adapter must hold relative intents; never pick first/sole grant, guess cwd, alter private context, bind context to room/work, or assume a shared filesystem.

For planned mutations, a selected workspace supplies routing only. Existing per-work grants, claims, exact participant consent and planned permit semantics remain stronger and unchanged. Their grantRevision still comes from the planned work grant, not this pointer/agent grant.
Default select/clear never releases existing locks, changes access grants, creates workers, changes bridge enrollment or admits business work.
GET metadata follows active credential plus administrator/owner authorization; it does not mint mutation authority. Existing native provenance and administrator checks remain mandatory on writes.
capabilityDiscovery: Existing bridge capability read adds resourceRouting=canonical-agent-resources/v1, resourceDefaults=true and resourceMetadata=true. Existing delivery-edit flags/protocol remain unchanged. Require the new capability before using new routes; no legacy fallback.

owners.Hollywood: Backend source/SQL/API and exact additive handoff
owners.LAX: Existing connector/installer integration delivery; passive handoff only
owners.Root: Existing installed ordinary edit and later actual provisioning/cooperation/cutover
